Third-party library: MediaPipe Pose (legacy solution), Apache-2.0.
Source: npm package @mediapipe/pose@0.5.1675469404 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/pose)
Files here are copied unmodified from that package; only the "lite" model
(pose_landmark_lite.tflite) is included. Used by bodylang.js to detect body landmarks
locally in the browser. No video or image data leaves the device.
